comments.body:
At some point, "static groupshared" is something that has meaning involving internal linkage etc. At the moment it seems that DXC is getting confused about this, hence this bug.

Short term, omitting static is the right fix to the shader code.

There's also a bug in the validator (or in the DXIL specs) since they're contradicting each other. We need to resolve this.

title: [DXIL] Incorrect codegen when using "static" on groupshared variables
